test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

STATIONARY
solution: The correct answer is '**Moving**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Stationary**' is '**Moving**'. • **Stationary**: not moving. (खड़ा हुआ; स्थिर, गतिहीन) • *Example: A car collided with a **stationary **vehicle.* • **Moving**: in motion. [गति में] • *Example: a deeply **moving** speech/story...* **Correct Answer:__** *Moving.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Still**: continuing until now or until the time you are talking about and not finishing. [अब भी (कहीं से आरंभ होकर अब तक या बात करने तक जारी रहते हुए)] • **Watch**: to look at somebody/something for a time, paying attention to what happens. [(किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को) ध्यान से देखना] • **Square**: a shape that has four straight sides of the same length and four angles of 90 degrees (right angles). [वर्ग (चार समान भुजाओं और चार समकोणों वाली आकृति)] 39:Ta0e, The correct answer is '**the**'.
